article.title: Parallel Legacies of Independent Thought: Ireland’sThe Bell and Australia’s Nation
article.author: Peter Gifford
article.content: Both journals sought to shatter national myths, force uncomfortable realities into public discussion, and give writers room to question the assumptions of powerful institutions. These two publications deserve attention today. The post Parallel Legacies of Independent Thought: Ireland’sThe Bell and Australia’s Nation appeared first on MR Online .
